summary: Rentokil Initial plc furnished a Form 6-K attaching a UK TR-1 major-holdings notification, the US-equivalent Schedule 13G-style disclosure, showing BlackRock, Inc. crossed the notification threshold on 28-Sep-2026. BlackRock's total position is 13.42% (339,573,725 voting rights): 9.98% direct shares, 3.44% via financial instruments, including American Depositary Receipts (2.42%), securities lending (0.84%), cash-settled CFDs (0.06%) and an ELN expiring 08/10/2026 (0.12%). Prior notification was 13.00%. The filing is a routine passive stake disclosure with no board recommendation, no transaction terms and no deal mechanics; no risk-arb angle applies.
